title: Glowing island with a palm tree
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- Water -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="46" ry="16" fill="#1a5a8a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="44" ry="14" fill="#1e7ab8"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="40" ry="11" fill="#2a9ad4"/>
  <!-- Water highlights -->
  <path d="M18 72 Q28 69 38 72" stroke="#6fd4ff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M56 75 Q66 72 76 75" stroke="#6fd4ff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M30 78 Q42 75 52 78" stroke="#4bc0f0" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Island sand -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="26" ry="9" fill="#c8a04a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="24" ry="8" fill="#e8c860"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="21" ry="6.5" fill="#ffd870"/>

  <path d="M36 63 Q46 60 58 62" stroke="#fff0a8" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <path d="M48 64 Q46 52 44 40 Q43 34 45 30" stroke="#8a5a20" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <path d="M45.5 56 L48.5 56" stroke="#6a4010" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M44.8 48 L47.8 48" stroke="#6a4010" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M44.2 40 L47.2 40" stroke="#6a4010" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Palm leaves -->
  <path d="M45 30 Q30 24 20 32 Q32 28 42 32" fill="#2ad060"/>
  <path d="M45 30 Q28 14 22 20 Q34 22 42 28" fill="#3ae070"/>
  <path d="M45 30 Q38 10 32 12 Q40 20 44 27" fill="#4af080"/>
  <path d="M45 30 Q55 12 62 16 Q52 22 47 28" fill="#3ae070"/>
  <path d="M45 30 Q62 20 70 28 Q56 26 47 31" fill="#2ad060"/>
  <path d="M45 30 Q58 32 64 40 Q54 34 46 33" fill="#4af080"/>
  <path d="M45 30 Q36 34 30 42 Q38 36 44 34" fill="#3ae070"/>
  <!-- Coconuts -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="32" r="2.5" fill="#8a5a20"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="33.5" r="2.2" fill="#a06a2a"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="33" r="2" fill="#7a4a15"/>
  <!-- Glow around tree -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="30" rx="20" ry="14" fill="#4af080" opacity="0.12"/>
  <!-- Small bush -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="63" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#28b850"/>
  <ellipse cx="61" cy="62" rx="4.5" ry="3" fill="#3ad060"/>
  <!-- Glowing edge on island -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="26" ry="9" fill="none" stroke="#ffe080" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/>
